text: Capacity planning — looking ahead, not just reacting to today's measured load.
Gradual growth, like a dashboard rolling out to three times as many dispatchers, gets projected forward. A known peak night, like New Year's Eve, gets temporary, deliberate overprovisioning instead.
A single day's utilization number says nothing about direction. A ninety-day rolling view shows whether consumption is flat, growing, or accelerating — the real signal to plan ahead.
Without planning, a SKU bump is reactive, discovered as a surprise bill. With planning, the cost of growth is a deliberate, budgeted decision made in advance.
The future stops being a surprise. Next up: blue-green and canary deployments — rolling out a change safely, at scale.
